routesHelp.message: Each capture is appended to the first route whose URL pattern matches. Mark a route as default (empty pattern) to catch unmatched URLs. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. github.com/anthropic/*. A single route can write to multiple files — pick the one your AI agent reads (CLAUDE.md for Claude Code, .cursorrules or .cursor/rules/*.mdc for Cursor, .windsurfrules for Windsurf, etc.) and add others with "+ Link another file".

mcpDirHelp.message: With the "Save to MCP contexts directory" output mode, each capture is written as a standalone .md file here. The companion MCP server then exposes these to Claude Code on demand — so your research and claude.ai conversations are available without bloating CLAUDE.md.

onboardingIntro.message: Three quick steps to start piping web context into your AI agent

onboardingStep1Desc.message: Point the extension at the file your AI agent reads — CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or similar. Every capture gets appended there. (An MCP contexts directory counts too.)

onboardingStep2Desc.message: Open any page worth keeping — a GitHub issue, a docs page, a claude.ai chat — then press Ctrl/⌘+Shift+L or click the toolbar icon. It lands in your linked file.

onboardingStep3Desc.message: Capture anytime from the toolbar icon, the keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+L for the page, Ctrl/⌘+Shift+K for a selection), or the right-click menu.

previewExpiredBody.message: The staged capture is no longer in session storage. This usually means the service worker restarted or the browser was closed. Trigger the capture again — the new preview will land here.

previewSkipFuture.message: Skip preview for future captures (re-enable in Options)
